work.author: Charles G. Herbermann and the Catholic Encyclopedia editorial board
work.description: The second volume (1907) of the sixteen-volume Catholic Encyclopedia (New York: Robert Appleton Company, 1907-1912). Signed articles are cited by article title; the volume's container identity remains distinct from each contributor's article. Sydney Smith's article 'St. Robert Francis Romulus Bellarmine' belongs to this volume.
work.title: The Catholic Encyclopedia, Volume 2
